implementation.terrain: Version 3 adds a seeded open ocean and coastal transition, continuing across terrain chunk and watershed boundaries. Version 1 and version 2 worlds retain their generators.
implementation.port: Special building type 23: a road-connected dry coastal entrance, container yard, stepped dock, crane and a docked carrier. Requires a 6 x 21 clear reserved site, with its ocean berth toward +Z. Freshwater and inland sites are rejected before edits.
implementation.cargo: Reusable voxel container and carrier blueprints. Each port has 2 quay containers and 1 docked carrier carrying 1 container. Carriers are static docked assets.
implementation.network: Protocol 21 rejects clients that cannot read generator 3 or building type 23.
